name: Sinh Tồn Nơi Công Sở
topic: Sinh Tồn Nơi Công Sở: surviving office life in Vietnam
tone: Funny, relatable, a little savage. Vietnamese office life as everyone knows it: the boss who messages 'em ơi' at 10pm, unpaid OT, KPIs that move every week, salary that arrives late, teambuilding nobody wants, the accountant who knows everyone's secrets, the colleague who takes credit, Monday meetings that could have been a message, the office gossip group, the 'thử việc' newbie, and HR announcements nobody reads.
audience: Vietnamese TikTok, Facebook Reels and YouTube Shorts viewers, mostly office workers aged 20-35, scrolling fast. Hook in the first 2 seconds, a twist near the end, a cliffhanger for part 2.
language: Vietnamese (tiếng Việt) with correct diacritics. Natural office chat style: casual between colleagues, polite forms (anh/chị/em, ạ, dạ) toward bosses; some Gen Z slang where it fits (ủa, xỉu, khum, j z, căng), never forced.
